endCard.title: Axial Plenum Fan
endCard.desc: EN 12101-3 certified, F300/F400 fire-rated axial plenum fan. High airflow capacity and low noise level for superior industrial ventilation performance.

pillars.title: We Understand the Project Before the Product
pillars.intro: Every project is assessed together with the building geometry, intended use, fire scenario, airflow, pressure requirements, and site conditions. Where needed, CFD analyses, fan selections, and system scenarios are built on engineering data.

pillars.title: We Manufacture the Designed Solution
pillars.intro: Approved technical data becomes project-specific fans, dampers, silencers, control panels, and auxiliary equipment within the NOVVES production infrastructure. The manufacturing process is managed with quality control, performance expectations, and standard requirements in view.

pillars.title: We Commission Systems That Work on Site
pillars.intro: The process does not end with product delivery. NOVVES focuses on correct on-site operation through installation coordination, commissioning support, control scenarios, technical documentation, and after-sales support.

engineeringShowcase.title: CFD-SUPPORTED ENGINEERING
engineeringShowcase.subtitle: Engineering That Makes Flow Visible
engineeringShowcase.body: Our process does not begin with product selection, but with understanding the building’s aerodynamic behaviour. NOVVES simulates the movement of smoke, heat, and air within the structure using CFD-based analyses; fan placement, flow rate, pressure, and scenario-based operating logic are validated with engineering data.

engineeringPillarsSection.title: From Engineering to the Field
engineeringPillarsSection.subtitle: End-to-End Solutions
engineeringPillarsSection.lead: NOVVES does not treat projects as product supply alone. We analyse the need, design the right system, manufacture it, and make it deployable on site.

video.title: Brand Introduction Video
video.desc: Get to know NOVVES's manufacturing facilities, engineering approach, and project experience up close.

items.a: NOVVES provides smoke extraction, comfort ventilation, and industrial air management solutions across a wide range of sectors including parking garages, tunnels, shopping malls, hospitals, hotels, industrial facilities, greenhouses, power plants, and residential buildings.

items.q: Which standards do your products comply with?
items.a: Our products are manufactured in compliance with EN 12101-3, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, CE, and ATEX standards, and are tested in accredited laboratories.

items.q: Do you provide CFD analysis services?
items.a: Yes, we perform 3D CFD simulations for each project to analyze smoke propagation, temperature, CO concentration, and visibility distance, optimizing jet fan placement.
We provide comprehensive after-sales support including commissioning, periodic maintenance, spare parts supply, and 24/7 technical service.
